description: This Java class 'OFBizHomeLocationResolver' implements LocationResolver and provides functionality to resolve a location string into a URL, based on the 'ofbiz.home' system property. It modifies the input location string to produce a properly formatted file URL, considering platform-specific file separators.

classes.name: OFBizHomeLocationResolver
classes.description: A location resolver that computes a file URL based on the 'ofbiz.home' environment variable and a given location string.

methods.name: resolveLocation
methods.description: Resolves a location string into a URL, using system property 'ofbiz.home'. Throws MalformedURLException if the property is not set or URL formation fails.
